description:
Make the coded and uncoded simulation flows consume framework-backed modems through the shared channel composition layer.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `SimulationRunner` can execute modem-backed coded and uncoded flows through the shared framework.
- [ ] Existing simulation entry points keep a coherent public API while using the new modem path internally.
- [ ] The integration path is reusable by both AWGN and existing fading models.

## Notes

This task follows the AWGN adapter and is the main integration point for the shared modem framework in the simulation harness.
title: Integrate modem composition into SimulationRunner
